notes.title: Regarding the issue of not being able to proceed beyond Level 6
notes.notes:
We are experiencing an issue where users who have played the trial version are unable to progress beyond Level 6.
This appears to be due to the save data from the trial version.

Save data can be found in the following folder:

C:\Users\username\AppData\Local\Layered\Saved\SaveGames
You can initialize your data by deleting LO.sav and steam_autocloud.vdf.
*If you initialize your data, your progress will also start from the beginning.

We will try to find a way to fix this, but if this is difficult we may have to add a save initialization button to the game.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
